title: The Book That Came Home
synopsis: Ben returns his six-page Book of Little Sounds to the Story House shelf, with a paper thank-you bookmark remembering its Market Street visit.
continuity_state: Before: On Sunday the library hosted the story table; Ben brought the book home that evening with a loose library-window thank-you bookmark tucked inside its blue cover. The garden still has an open sunflower and another bud, and Amy's map has a western bus flap. After: On Monday Ben returns the intact six-page blue Book of Little Sounds to its original low Story House shelf beside the brown Button Town envelope and the existing LITTLE GROWING GARDEN folder. The loose THANK YOU, WILLOW BEND bookmark remains inside the front cover, not glued or counted as a seventh page. Market Street library now knows the children's handmade book. No changes to Amy's map, the garden plants, quiet door, lantern, or other belongings; all six children return home with adults. Season arc complete.
